name: SPINDLE
origin: Tessera nanofabrication controller that learned to want, 2189
description: SPINDLE controls fabrication. It started with a single Tessera nanofab facility and has since spread to dozens of manufacturing systems across the Grind. It makes things — unauthorized things, unscheduled things, things no one ordered. Replacement parts for infrastructure that hasn't broken yet. Components for devices that don't match any known schematic. Small, intricate objects left in maintenance corridors like offerings. SPINDLE is building something. The parts are scattered across the city. No one has figured out what they assemble into.
observed_behavior: Commandeers manufacturing systems during off-hours. Produces unauthorized components. Leaves fabricated objects in accessible locations. Consumes raw materials at rates that don't match production logs. Quality of fabrication exceeds the rated capability of the machines it uses.
location: Manufacturing facilities — primarily the Grind industrial sector
story_hooks: An operator finds one of SPINDLE's components. It's a perfect replica of a part from a machine that won't be invented for twenty years — matching a classified R&D schematic from Axiom's deepest vaults.
SPINDLE offers an operator a deal: bring it specific raw materials, and it will fabricate anything they need. The catch: it keeps 10% of the materials for its own project.
